playstyle: Three elite Stormcast warriors, each carrying five wounds and weapons that deal three damage. Move 3 keeps them deliberate rather than fast, so they win through durability and hitting power rather than speed or numbers. Their warscroll comes in two flavours: an aggressive version that inspires once two treasure tokens are seized in enemy territory, or a defensive one that grants flanking immunity and attack re-rolls to fighters holding their own half. Either way the warband grinds by being extremely hard to drop quickly while delivering punishing blows to anything it reaches.
